title: Top Travel Backpacks for Carry-On Trips (2026)
summary: Three travel backpacks for 2026, chosen from Amazon listing details: the Tortuga Travel Backpack Lite 40L for a full carry-on, the Peak Design Travel Backpack 45L for an expandable pack, and the Osprey Daylite Expandable 26+6 as a smaller personal-item pack.
method: These picks come from Amazon listing details (sizes, materials, features and ratings), not from review-site tests.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the source excerpts, so all price fields are null. No discount or deal information is available, so deal_note is null.

products.name: Tortuga Travel Backpack Lite 40L
why: It holds 40 liters and measures 22 x 14 x 8 inches, within carry-on limits.
It has a hip belt, sternum strap and load lifters, plus a suitcase-style front opening.
specs: Hip belt, sternum strap, load lifters
products.benefit: Picture a week-long trip with one bag: the front-loading opening works like a suitcase, and the hip belt takes weight off your shoulders. A separate laptop compartment fits up to 16 inches. Among the backpacks here, it is the full-size 40L option. The catch: it is expensive and has fewer ratings than the others.
products.amazon_listing: Tortuga 40L Travel Backpack Lite, Black - Large Carry-On Travel Bag | For Men and Women -
products.desc: A 40L carry-on travel backpack in 630D CORDURA nylon with YKK zippers. A separate compartment holds a laptop up to 16 inches.

products.name: Peak Design Travel Backpack 45L
why: It expands from 35 to 45 liters and has rear and top access.
The shell is weatherproof 400D recycled nylon canvas.
cons: Expanded size may exceed airline limits
products.best_for: Travelers who want a bag that adjusts
products.benefit: Picture a trip that grows: expand the pack when you shop. The luggage pass-through and hidden carry straps help in transit. Among the backpacks here, it is the one that expands. The catch: it is the most expensive of the three, and an expanded 45L may not fit every airline's carry-on limit.
products.amazon_listing: Peak Design Travel Backpack 45L, Black, Expandable 35-45L Design, Rear and Top Access, Wea
products.desc: A 45L expandable travel backpack with tuck-away straps and a laptop sleeve up to 17 inches. Check airline limits when expanded.

products.name: Osprey Daylite Expandable Travel Pack 26+6
why: The main compartment expands by 2 inches to add 6 liters.
It is sized as a personal item for most major airlines.
products.skip_if: You pack for a week or more
products.benefit: Picture a short trip where you want to skip checked bags: the AirScape back panel keeps your back cool. Two bottle pockets and a tech sleeve help. Among the backpacks here, it is the smallest and cheapest. The catch: it is a personal item size, so it carries less.
products.amazon_listing: Osprey Daylite Expandable 26+6 Travel Pack, Blue Spikemoss/Alkaline
products.desc: A 26-liter travel pack that expands to 32 liters. It is a personal-item size, not a full week-long pack.
